description: Sunburst Plume shows a hierarchy as rings, from the center to the edge: region, country, city; department, item, supplier. Drop 1 to 8 fields in Groups and a measure in Size. Two modes: Explore, where a click opens the level beneath with an animated zoom, a breadcrumb and the center to go back, or All levels, where every ring is shown and a click filters the page. Free features, no watermark Explore: choose how many levels show at once, a thin cue marks the sectors that open, click the center or the breadcrumb to go back; a click can open, open and filter, or just select. Readable labels: they follow the arcs when they fit, turn radial otherwise, and never show upside down; name, value, % of parent, of total or of the opened sector. Center: total, opened or hovered sector, with its share of the parent. Others: beyond a number of sectors per parent, the smallest are grouped; ragged hierarchies stop cleanly. Colors: one color per branch, lighter outward, or a single color. Power BI: tooltips and tooltip pages, cross-filtering, highlighting, right-click menu everywhere, keyboard and screen reader, high contrast, English and French, dynamic formatting with DAX, up to 1,000,000 rows. Premium features ★ Play axis: drop a year or a date in Play axis and press play: the arcs grow and shrink from one year to the next, branch colors and the opened sector stay put.
